answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The island holds work receipts rather than names, so the haven of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, slashed on a failed audit. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the jetty of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
